payload.body: You tend to recognize that a new role, relationship, or direction will not work if you keep using the version of yourself that fits other people's expectations. The next step often includes a preference or boundary you used to hide. Underneath is the old belief that growth should make you more acceptable, not more honest. Include one real preference in the next decision instead of presenting the approved version of progress.
payload.astroHint: Lilith conjunct the North Node can make growth require a less acceptable or more independent part of you to become visible.
